slug: 2025-06-12 Zambia says using multiple strategies to meet 50 percent birth registration goal by 2026

systems.system: Three-month registration campaign for birth certificates and National Registration Cards
systems.tiers: launched April 2025; intended to register around 3.5 million people

systems.owner: Department of National Registration, Passports and Citizenship, Ministry of Home Affairs and Internal Security
systems.tiers: planned; the Registrar General aims to have digital IDs in place by the end of 2027

note: No civil registration system is named or described. The Registrar General speaks of transforming civil registration through digitisation, of a roadmap and of backing from government and international partners, without naming a system, a plan document, offices or a record method. Also stated: 14 percent of births registered as of 2024 (UNICEF); six percent of registered children hold a certificate; target of 50 percent by the end of 2026; UNICEF advises linking health facilities to the civil registration system and more funding.
